claims.claim: The pure RA-5 provider request and return bind validated research material to deterministic, provider-independent identities. Refreshed predecessor validation uses a caller-supplied witness outside serialized artifacts; Stage-2 revalidates the exact Stage-1 semantic basis and lineage.

The preserved adapter surface enforces closed manifest and invocation grammar, explicit single-call selection, public HTTP destination guarding, and deterministic normalization into RA-2 observations and an acquisition attempt.

Focused provider and adapter regressions cover the required portability, lineage, access, destination, attribution, failure-mapping, and witness cases. The repair changed only the two scoped provider files; the focused provider tests passed.
